title: Acute myeloid leukemia-induced functional inhibition of healthy CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells
description: Exposure to AML-derived supernatants significantly inhibited proliferation, cell cycling, colony formation and differentiation of healthy CD34+ HSPC. RNA sequencing of healthy CD34+ HSPC after exposure to leukemic conditions revealed a specific signature of genes related to proliferation, cell cycle regulation and differentiation thereby reflecting their functional inhibition on a molecular level. Overall design: Healthy CD34+ HSPC are exposed to AML-derived supernatants
